rationale: The shed door sensor (SEN-D1) showed RSSI -88 dBm, below the -80 dBm threshold that causes intermittent disconnections, while all other devices were online. The problem began after the metal shed was installed, which strongly attenuates the sub-GHz signal. Relocation did not help, but installing the official RP-1 repeater resolved the issue and the sensor has stayed online since — confirming weak signal as the root cause.

repair_steps: Confirm the shed door sensor has remained online since installing the RP-1 repeater.
